caption: Air at 6 bar goes through the FRL unit and a solenoid-operated 5/2 valve to a 50 mm bore cylinder, which pushes 1060 N. The valve is the electro-pneumatic interface.

spec.title: Pneumatic actuation chain
spec.aria: Compressed air at 6 bar passes through a filter-regulator-lubricator unit and a 5/2 solenoid valve into a 50 mm bore cylinder that pushes a 1060 N load.
